en: Hold and drag to draw track. Walls and basic houses and natural obstacles may be cleared. Avoid water and mountains and farms and major buildings. Join the stations from either side at their vertical midpoint. Cities still pay to build trains.

en: Erase track while preserving terrain and buildings. Affected lines are revoked and trains seek a safe return. Redraw or ask the city to reconnect to resume service.
